title: This reportedly haunted Texas hotel in Seguin is an Airbnb Halloween pick
byline: KENS 5FollowDarcy RamirezThu, October 22, 2026 at 4:03 PM UTCAdd to Preferred Sources
content:
Just east of San Antonio, the small town of Seguin has a piece of Texas history with a spooky reputation that could make it a destination for Halloween travelers.

The Magnolia Hotel Bed & Breakfast dates back to 1850, when it served as a frontier hotel and stagecoach stop. Today, the historic property is known for reported paranormal activity, drawing interest from those fascinated by ghost stories and the unexplained.

Now, the Seguin landmark is getting attention as part of Airbnb's 2026 Halloween travel collection, which features 31 stays around the world for travelers looking to make a getaway out of spooky season.

According to Airbnb, the hotel's second floor is considered its most haunted area. The space includes an unrestored, 11-room wing without electricity, adding to the property's eerie atmosphere.

For the full Airbnb listing for The Magnolia Hotel Bed & Breakfast, click here.

Halloween getaways are gaining popularity

The Seguin property is featured as Halloween travel becomes more popular, according to Airbnb's 2026 Halloween Travel Trends Report.

Searches for stays over Halloween weekend are up nearly 15% year over year, while wish lists with Halloween-inspired titles have increased by nearly 60%, Airbnb reported. Gen Z travelers are also helping drive the trend, with searches from the group up nearly 45% year over year.

The report points to growing interest in smaller towns and lesser-known destinations with stories to tell, rather than traditional trips to major cities.

The Magnolia Hotel is one of 31 stays Airbnb is highlighting for October. The collection features a variety of spooky-season destinations, including gothic estates, pop culture landmarks, witch-inspired retreats, cabins tucked into the woods and homes that hosts describe as haunted.

Each offers a different way to celebrate the season, whether travelers are drawn to historic buildings, supernatural stories or an atmospheric escape. For the full list of spooky getaway locations, click here.
